test_title: PYST 41: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

W sits third to the left of O. X sits second to the left of Y. O is the immediate neighbour of both N and X. P is not an immediate neighbour of W.

How many people sit between M and X when counted from the right of M?
solution:
**Given: **M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. W sits third to the left of O.

2. O is the immediate neighbour of both N and X.

3. X sits second to the left of Y.

4. P is not an immediate neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/585aecec6783e6695dc8e7b968305e53988ac99d687b94560816579ed110f64d.png] 

M, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79f5eaf0021666a0e149780d858e15b1912ef75c031b63540645e1977edd70e0.png] 

Thus, two people sit between M and X when counted from the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
